---
title: "BGG Collection Reports"
subtitle: "What does a model think about your boardgame collection?"
---

```{python}
#| label: list-collections
#| include: false
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_project_root = os.environ.get("BGG_PROJECT_ROOT") or os.getcwd()
if _project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _project_root)

# Discover the available per-user reports by listing the wrappers
# generated under collections/. Anything else (e.g. fixture_user) is
# explicitly filtered upstream when the wrappers are generated.
collections_dir = Path("collections")
users = sorted(p.stem for p in collections_dir.glob("*.qmd"))
```

```{python}
#| label: user-grid
#| output: asis
if not users:
    print(
        "_No user reports have been generated yet. Run "
        "`just build-site` to build them._"
    )
else:
    # Wrap in a raw HTML block so Pandoc doesn't try to interpret the
    # `<a>` closing tags as Markdown — that's what produced the phantom
    # empty card before.
    print("```{=html}")
    print('<div class="user-grid">')
    for u in users:
        print(
            f'<a class="user-card" href="collections/{u}.html">'
            f'<div class="user-card-title">{u}</div>'
            f'<div class="user-card-sub">View report →</div>'
            f"</a>"
        )
    print("</div>")
    print("```")
```

## About

This site collects per-user reports for a classification model that
predicts whether a BoardGameGeek user owns a given game. Each report
covers the same sections — collection composition, what the model
learned, performance on held-out games, and predictions for new and
upcoming releases.

Pick a user from the sidebar (or the cards above) to view their report.
